capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: English Wikipedia: 17.6 kWh battery for the 2017 car (label not stated).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: German Wikipedia table: ED4/EQ 2017-24, 16.7 kWh usable. CONFLICT: English Wikipedia says 17.2 kWh of the total can power the fortwo (16.7 for the forfour, citation needed).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: GUESS: Wikipedia says "LG chemistry composing of 96 cells"; LG Chem cells are NMC but no page says so. Owner decision.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: GUESS: no page states the pack voltage; the 2017 pack has 96 cells in series (Wikipedia), about 350 V nominal, and the ED2/ED3 packs are assumed the same class. Owner decision.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Green Cars Compare: no DC fast charging, and no battery-warming feature is described for the smart ED on any page opened.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: same hardware as the 2017 US car (7.2 kW); 2018-2019 only changed trim naming / EQ branding per Wikipedia; compared 2017 with 2018.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Green Cars Compare (ED2 page): "does not support DC fast charging"; other years assumed the same (EPA lists only 240 V charge times; the 2012 optional quick-charge announcement was for Europe).
